title: Prepare Overlay repository for new Build process

raw.title: Prepare Overlay repository for new Build process
raw.body: For the upcoming Overlays 1.2 release, we should prepare to be an early adopter of the new https://github.com/oai/build-infra approach - the README on that project has instructions for the changes that are made and how the release process works. We may need to expand this issue description or put together a checklist of actions needed.
